correctness.rationale: The proof establishes a direct if-and-only-if read-distance-two alternating-interval lemma, a conserved alternating incidence sum over a torsion-free group, a support-star dichotomy, and complete equality rigidity. Repeated read supports produce coordinate stars of size at most q; distinct supports share a read coordinate and give at most n+1, with equality exactly the deletion family of a full alternating predecessor. Counts include n=1 and the q=n+1 tie. All 20 small parameter graphs were independently enumerated in the included standalone script; finite enumeration supports but does not replace the all-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: Direct comparison of Sun–Ge 2024 full text (§§III–IV) isolates a known exact edge criterion and exhibited local cliques, but not a universal clique-number upper bound or complete classification/count of all maximum families. Cai et al. 2020 treat insertion/deletion read-ball overlap and redundancy. Banerjee et al. 2023 treat composition-read code bounds, chiefly binary longer windows. The proof here adds a torsion-free signed-incidence argument that forbids a triangular arrangement of read-error supports, followed by sharp equality rigidity. Four topic-specific database/primary-literature searches found no equivalent maximum clique theorem; an unlocated general clique result remains the principal originality risk.
residual_risks: A more general theorem on constrained Hamming equidistant codes or insertion-reconstruction graph cliques might imply this classification without matching titles.
The inspected primary literature does not amount to an exhaustive guarantee of global novelty; inaccessible/unindexed sources could remain.

value.rationale: The finite-state composition-read channel is a natural DNA nanopore sensing model. The exact maximum clique number is a graph invariant controlling pairwise one-substitution confusion clusters; the theorem classifies all extremal configurations, reveals a sharp crossover when alphabet size meets word length, and provides exact labeled multiplicities. The result is structurally stronger than edge counts or one constructed clique and is not simply a finite sample or arbitrary parameter slice.
